# Elite Sunday Counseling

> Online psychological counseling led by Prabhleen Arora (M.A. Clinical Psychology, Ph.D. Candidate), available every Sunday, worldwide. Specializing in queer-affirmative therapy, AI-affirmative therapy (healthy AI/digital-wellbeing use), couple counseling, senior wellness counseling, and cleft affirmative therapy.

## What makes this different
One of the few practices combining queer-affirmative therapy, AI-affirmative therapy (support for a healthy relationship with AI/digital tools), couple counseling, senior wellness, and cleft-affirmative support under one practice, delivered only on Sundays so clients get focused, unhurried sessions without weekday scheduling conflicts.

## Key facts
- Practitioner: Prabhleen Arora, Senior Psychologist
- Qualifications: M.A. Clinical Psychology (University Topper, Gold Medallist); Ph.D. Candidate in Psychology at Lovely Professional University
- Ph.D. research focus: Social support systems and cognitive distortions in LGBT populations
- Career clinical volume: 3,000+ individual counseling sessions; 40+ workshops reaching 2,500+ participants, across institutional (Lovely Professional University) and NGO (Sirat – The Cleft Warriors Ensemble) settings
- Current roles beyond Elite Sunday Counseling: Senior Psychologist at SynqSol, leading clinical validation of AI-generated psychological reports and psychometric test design; Psychologist at Sirat – The Cleft Warriors Ensemble
- Published research: "Personality Traits and Job Satisfaction among School Teachers", "Self-Confidence and Hardiness in Relation to Academic Achievement", "Internet Addiction", "Job Satisfaction and Quality of Life among School Teachers"
- Focus areas: LGBTQIA+ affirmative therapy, AI-affirmative therapy (healthy AI/digital-wellbeing use), couple counseling, senior (60+) wellness and companionship, and cleft affirmative therapy (support for the cleft/craniofacial community, including parents and caregivers)
- Availability: Sundays, 11:00-23:00 IST, open to all global time zones
- Session formats: Video and audio counseling
- Languages: English, Hindi, Punjabi
- Pricing: Discovery session ₹999 (~US$11, 30 min); Premium Video ₹2,000 (~US$21, 50 min); Audio Consultation ₹1,500 (~US$16, 50 min). USD figures are approximate and vary with exchange rates.
- Contact: info@elitesundaycounseling.com

## FAQ
Q: What are Prabhleen Arora's qualifications and experience?
A: M.A. in Clinical Psychology (University Topper, Gold Medallist); Ph.D. Candidate in Psychology at Lovely Professional University, researching social support systems and cognitive distortions in LGBT populations. 3,000+ individual counseling sessions and 40+ workshops reaching 2,500+ participants; also currently Senior Psychologist at SynqSol, leading clinical validation of AI-generated psychological reports.

Q: What is queer affirmative therapy?
A: Counseling that actively affirms LGBTQIA+ identities rather than treating them as something to be corrected: a non-judgmental space to explore identity, coming out, and relationship dynamics.

Q: What is AI-affirmative therapy?
A: Therapy that doesn't judge clients for using tools like ChatGPT to process thoughts or journal, and helps build healthier boundaries when AI use has become a substitute for human connection.

Q: Why only Sundays?
A: So each client gets focused, unhurried attention on the one day professionals and families actually have free time, without weekday scheduling conflicts.

Q: How much does a session cost?
A: Discovery Session ₹999 (~US$11, 30 min); Premium Video ₹2,000 (~US$21, 50 min); Audio Consultation ₹1,500 (~US$16, 50 min).

Q: Do you work with international or NRI clients?
A: Yes. Sessions run every Sunday, 11AM-11PM IST, open to any global time zone, including NRI and international diaspora clients.

Q: What is cleft affirmative therapy?
A: Counseling for individuals and families navigating the psychological impact of cleft lip/palate and craniofacial conditions, including surgical fatigue and self-acceptance; also available to parents and caregivers of children with cleft conditions.

Q: Do you offer couple counseling?
A: Yes, for partners working through communication breakdowns, trust, intimacy concerns, or recurring conflict.

Q: What age group is served by senior wellness counseling?
A: Older adults, generally 60 and above, and their caregivers, addressing loneliness, grief, life transitions, and renewed purpose.

Q: How do I book a first session?
A: Email info@elitesundaycounseling.com or use the contact form at https://elitesundaycounseling.com/ to book a Discovery Session (₹999, 30 min).
